human_in_loop_decisions: Any decision that changes access to care, to employment or to grade progression stays with a named human who sees the underlying evidence, can override without approval and leaves a reason record.
strongest_guardrails: No autonomous decision at the high-stakes moment, a hard stop threshold that pauses the feature, subgroup monitoring instead of average accuracy, and a fallback path that still works when the model is off.
cross_industry_pattern: In all three industries the harm did not start at the model. It started where a convenient proxy stood in for the real outcome. The healthcare evidence cited here is direct: a cost proxy stood in for illness, and the error landed hardest on the patients with the least prior contact with the system. Group members reported the same shape from their own sources, past hires standing in for future performance in hiring and engagement standing in for learning in tutoring. The release gate therefore has to be subgroup evidence and a working fallback, not headline accuracy.
